summary: Implemented universal Control, colored workspace groups and free spatial navigation. Signed pane positions persist outside workspace squares; pan tool, Space-drag and middle-drag work over native panes; fit/minimap include displaced panes. Typecheck/build passed; installed plugin reloaded. Live Playwright confirmed negative movement, reload persistence, 150px pan, zoom and narrow layout without page errors. Unit tests and formal review remain pending; browser captures are snapshots, not interactive streams. Implementation commit ca6a0a73; target sync current with main.

state.request: Create a new BB plugin named Agent Canvas based closely on the supplied reference screenshot. Build a full-screen dark spatial canvas with draggable/resizable live thread panes using native ThreadChat, a persistent Coordinator native chat docked on the right, a compact workspace tab strip and add control, dotted background, minimap, zoom/fit/reorganize controls, and pane title/status metadata. Coordinator selection or creation must be an explicit user action through native BB controls; never autonomously spawn or message agents. Use current public Plugin SDK surfaces, preserve authorization and permission modes, persist bounded canvas layout safely, provide keyboard and narrow-screen fallbacks, add the package to the workspace catalog, install/reload it locally, and verify the visual experience against the screenshot without copying AgentGrid branding or proprietary assets.
